race.comment: NEWY (2) ran a short priced favourite when first up over this course and distance and got the job done sweetly. He doesn't mind it on the fresh side and handles all types of going. Should sit in the right spot and prove very difficult to run by. WILD MONARCH (8) has done little wrong himself. He came from a long way off them at his last run. He does bring in the fitness advantage. CARMINE (9) is possibly better suited when racing over further however he has shown ability. WISHFUL THINKER (1) could push forward from the barrier with his gate speed. DIRTY DOES IT (7) returned to the winners' circle after a long while in the wilderness last time out over 1100m at this track, scoring by 1.5 lengths. Include.
